name: MIRA X
summary: MIRA X is the bipedal humanoid in Midea's service-robot development program. It extends the MIRA direction toward a walking human-shaped platform for commercial and household environments. Midea identifies the model in its annual reporting, while detailed task performance and production configuration remain dependent on the development version.
